title: Great Hanshin Earthquake
summary: A large earthquake struck the Ōsaka-Kōbe (Hanshin) area of western Japan, among the country's strongest, deadliest and costliest. Estimated deaths were 6,400, with 40,000 injured and over 300,000 homeless. It exposed weak infrastructure and poor disaster preparedness, leading to reinforced structures and revised national response policies.
